The '''Annaj-Houche Run''', also known simply as the '''Houche Run''', was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] located in the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]], on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that served the [[Inner Moddell systems]]. The route began at [[Annaj/Legends|Annaj]] and passed through the [[Ovise system/Legends|Ovise system]], [[Thonner/Legends|Thonner]], and [[Maya Kovel/Legends|Maya Kovel]], before reaching its terminus at [[Houche]].
